selection.rule: Test only if spec/prec/F1/acc floors hold AND accuracy, recall, and precision are all at least as good as baseline validation, with at least one strictly better.

interpretation.detail: Mild contrast augmentation did not provide a balanced validation improvement (failures: ['specificity 0.8007 < 0.82', 'precision 0.7578 < 0.78', 'f1 0.7942 < 0.80', 'accuracy 0.8150 < 0.82']). Retain the 83.42% baseline.
